name: dombastis-kitchen
description: Website Kuliner DOMBASTIS KITCHEN - Aneka Olahan Kambing, Nasi Briyani & Masakan Aqiqah

scripts.build:css: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const css=fs.readFileSync('src/css/style.css','utf8'); const minCss=css.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/\s*([\{\}:;,])\s*/g,'$1').trim(); fs.writeFileSync('dist/css/styles.min.css',minCss); console.log('CSS built successfully: dist/css/styles.min.css');"
scripts.build:js: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const js=fs.readFileSync('src/js/main.js','utf8'); const minJs=js.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/\/\/.*/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); fs.writeFileSync('dist/js/main.min.js',minJs); console.log('JS built successfully: dist/js/main.min.js');"
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:theme

author: DOMBASTIS KITCHEN
